title: Circuit built from the search state
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and for each natural number $j$ let $D_j$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit with $n+j$ inputs. Suppose every $D_j$ has distinct input vertices at each gate, every NOT gate has exactly one input, and every gate has at most two inputs. For each natural number $m$, form a multi-output directed acyclic Boolean circuit with $n$ inputs whose gate list and ordered output list are the two components of the search state at stage $m$.
hypotheses_covered: For each natural number $j$, a directed acyclic Boolean circuit $D_j$ with $n+j$ inputs.
Every gate of every $D_j$ has distinct input vertices.
Every NOT gate of every $D_j$ has exactly one input.
Every gate of every $D_j$ has at most two inputs.
